name: io.github.JOSETRA44/scopus-mcp
title: Scopus
description: Search Elsevier Scopus: papers, abstracts, author h-index and year-by-year citation timelines. Requires a free Elsevier API key.

environmentVariables.name: SCOPUS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Elsevier API key, free from https://dev.elsevier.com/. Required.

environmentVariables.name: SCOPUS_INST_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Institutional token. Required only for author profiles and citation overviews, and only works from a subscribing institution's network.
